text_block_list.name: Comedians on TV
text_block_list.text:
"You know, there are two things I'm really 
good at. And those are dancing and moving 
to the beat."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! They're both the same thing!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
What the heck are you sayin'! —Heheheh. 
Seriously, you're always clowning 
around...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, ngh... *cough, hack*...! Oh no, 
this... I might've really messed up...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Lucky Lilac ended up hurting her 
throat from playing the straight man way 
too much...
